t: A Microchip microcontroller with built-in Ethernet and CAN for wired control projects.
steps: Buy the SAM E54 Xplained Pro kit from a parts distributor for about $110.
Plug the kit into your computer with a micro USB cable.
Flash the UF2 bootloader using the steps on the CircuitPython board page.
Download CircuitPython for the SAM E54 Xplained board and copy it onto the board.
Install the Mu or Thonny editor.
Open code.py and try the blink example on the user LED.
Move to Zephyr or RIOT later to try Ethernet and CAN bus.
meta: Open Code. From $111. A few stores.
